AUTOMATED AM-CM PROCESS In this subsection, the detail so automating the additive manufacturing-compression overmolded process are presented. In the previous sections, the tailored polymer composite preforms were first fabricated using big area additive manufacturing and then pre-heated before transferring into compression press for overmolding. To avoid additional heating and to ensure the smooth and rapid production of AM-CM parts an automated system was developed. The system includes tailoring the toolpath to obtain the desired fiber orientation allowing tunability in mechanical properties, to rapidly printing with optimal parameters for a given materials in custom shaped molds, to subsequent compression molding under pressure in a hydraulic press to obtain the net shape high quality surface finish part. The toolpath during additive manufacturing can be tailored to obtain desired fiber orientation and mechanical properties. A numerical model based on computational fluid dynamics to predict the polymer flow as well the fiber orientation within the beads during just additive manufacturing as well as subsequent compression molding was developed recently [16,17]. Once the orientation tensors were determined from the numerical analysis, the mechanical properties can be predicted using the micromechanics theories and de-homogenization techniques implemented in MCQ Chopped software [18]. Thus, a complete automation of the AM-CM process linking the toolpath, fiber orientation, and mechanical properties can be established which is a part of our on-going work. To illustrate the capability of the developed automated AM-CM system, a circular mold was used as shown in Fig 6.1. The toolpath can be rectilinear and concentric, or any other pattern required to get the desired properties. Here, a concentric tool path was chosen, and the material is extruded as shown in the figure below. Upon extruding the material in a concentric manner, an additively manufactured circular shaped part is obtained as shown in the Fig. 6.1. Upon compression overmolding this part, a net shape high surface quality finish part can be obtained rapidly with the desired shape.
